talents.name: Armor Master
talents.description: Grants advantage on relevant saves and satisfies the strength requirement for medium and heavy armor.

backgrounds.name: Roadwarden
backgrounds.description: You keep civilization's roads open against beasts and people who threaten them.

backgrounds.name: Ranger
backgrounds.description: You feel alive in forests, surviving from what you can find and hunt.

backgrounds.name: Bounty Hunter
backgrounds.description: You bring back people who run for those willing to pay.

backgrounds.name: Outlaw
backgrounds.description: You are a romantic and ambitious rogue with a reputation to uphold.

backgrounds.name: Soldier
backgrounds.description: You survived war and now sell your experience to those who can pay.

backgrounds.name: Knight
backgrounds.description: You are an elite professional soldier attended by a squire.

backgrounds.name: Duelist
backgrounds.description: You wield sword and pistol in matters of honor.

backgrounds.name: Slayer
backgrounds.description: You hunt literal and metaphorical monsters, starting with vampires.

backgrounds.name: Exorcist
backgrounds.description: You banish spirits from people and places.

backgrounds.name: Warpriest
backgrounds.description: You are a warrior bound by an oath in the cosmic war.

backgrounds.name: Initiate
backgrounds.description: You joined a religious order for its mysteries, truths, and beer.

backgrounds.name: Charlatan
backgrounds.description: You rely on wit and deception to come into money.

backgrounds.name: Wizard's Apprentice
backgrounds.description: Your master sent you away to see the world and travel with mortals.

backgrounds.name: Warlock
backgrounds.description: You made a deal with an otherworldly being and gained strange powers.

backgrounds.name: Alchemist
backgrounds.description: You seek transformations, discoveries, and someone to fund your experiments.

backgrounds.name: Witch
backgrounds.description: You preserve community wisdom while hiding from threatened authorities.

backgrounds.name: Rat Catcher
backgrounds.description: You ply a necessary trade in towns with no shortage of rats.

backgrounds.name: Beggar
backgrounds.description: You survive on the streets while most people ignore you.

backgrounds.name: Grave Robber
backgrounds.description: You profit from possessions the dead no longer need.

backgrounds.name: Burglar
backgrounds.description: You relieve people of the burden of their wealth.

items.name: Supply
effects: May be exchanged for a simple commonly available item, used to restore 1 Armor Value, or used to restore one worn weapon.

items.name: Torch
effects: Burns for 6 turns and provides 5 Light Points.

items.name: Polearm
effects: reach

items.name: Crossbow
effects: long range

items.name: Ammo
effects: After combat in which its ranged weapon was used, a d6 result of 1 leaves one shot before removal.

items.name: Roadwarden writ
effects: Shows the roadwarden's powers and legal rights.

items.name: Longbow
effects: long range

items.name: Trap
effects: On a failed STR save, the target is stuck.

items.name: Pistol
effects: loud

items.name: Suit of Mail
effects: Disadvantage on DEX saves while worn.

items.name: Shield
effects: May be sundered to block all damage from one suitable attack, then is destroyed.

items.name: Heavy Plate Armor
effects: Disadvantage on DEX saves while worn.

items.name: Longsword
effects: reach

items.name: Holy Water
effects: Bypasses Armor Value when an undead target is doused.

items.name: Silver knife
effects: Counts as a silver weapon and checks for wear after every attack.

items.name: Brigandine
effects: Disadvantage on DEX saves while worn.

items.name: Warhammer
effects: reach

items.name: Book of hymns, prayers, or theology
Unnaturally glowing eyes
effects: Grant night vision.

items.name: Chest of alchemy equipment
effects: Contains an alembic, portal athanor, dishes, bottles, vials, and raw materials.

items.name: Tonic of Health
effects: Heals d6 stamina, d4 STR, and any physical affliction when drunk.

items.name: Soft shoes
effects: Grant advantage on relevant saves.

items.name: Hooded cloak
effects: Grants advantage on relevant saves.

companions.name: War Horse
abilities: When not in melee and running from nearby to close, a rider using a lance deals double damage.
When in melee, horse and rider can both attack.
